SELECT 
  dir_paissubdiv.Descr AS Departamento,
  COUNT(*) AS TotalRegistros
FROM
  flow_coordina f
  INNER JOIN pac_ficha ON f.CodPac = pac_ficha.Cod
  INNER JOIN salud_paciente ON pac_ficha.Cod = salud_paciente.NroHistoria
  INNER JOIN dir_comunica ON salud_paciente.k_id = dir_comunica.IdRegistro
  INNER JOIN dir_comunicadir ON dir_comunicadir.IdComunica = dir_comunica.k_id
  INNER JOIN dir_paislocalidad ON dir_paislocalidad.k_id = dir_comunicadir.IdLocalidad
  INNER JOIN dir_paissubdiv ON dir_paissubdiv.k_id = dir_paislocalidad.IdPaisSubDiv
WHERE
dir_comunicadir.IdLocalidad > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') > 2004 AND f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
            [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
  
GROUP BY
  dir_paissubdiv.Descr
ORDER BY
  TotalRegistros DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(fc.EdadCoo) AS Promedio,
    s.Descr AS Sexo
FROM flow_coordina fc
INNER JOIN salud_paciente sp ON sp.NroHistoria = fc.CodPac
INNER JOIN dir_sexo s ON s.k_id = sp.IdSexo AND sp.IdSexo > 0
WHERE fc.Realizado = 255 AND fc.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120) AND DATE_FORMAT(fc.`FechaRealizado`, '%Y') > 2004 AND DATE_FORMAT(fc.`FechaRealizado`, '%Y') <= {{anio}}

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(fc.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND fc.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND fc.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(fc.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
GROUP BY Sexo;

SELECT 
    SUM(p.VentilaH + (p.VentilaD * 24)) AS Horas FROM sqlpvd_masterpp p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ff.Cod
    FROM flow_coordina ff
    WHERE ff.Realizado = 255

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(ff.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND ff.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND ff.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(ff.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
      AND ff.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
    ORDER BY ff.FechaRealizado DESC
    LIMIT 35
) sub
    ON p.CodMaster = sub.Cod

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM flow_coordina f
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ff.Cod
    FROM flow_coordina ff
    WHERE ff.Realizado = 255

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
      AND ff.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
    ORDER BY ff.FechaRealizado DESC
    LIMIT 35
) sub
    ON f.CodActo = sub.Cod
INNER JOIN flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle bd 
    ON bd.CodMaster = f.Cod 
   AND (
        bd.CodDiagno1 != 1100 OR

        bd.CodDiagno3 != 1100 OR

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y-%m') AS Periodo,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.Cod) AS Total
FROM sqlflow_coordina f
WHERE Not CodCoordinaReglaMotivo=190 AND CodCoordinaReglaMotivo<1000 AND ( Realizado=255 AND DATE_FORMAT(FechaRealizado,'%Y') = {{anio}} ) AND CodTecnicaDetalle=106 

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
GROUP BY Periodo
ORDER BY Periodo

  INNER JOIN salud_paciente ON pac_ficha.Cod = salud_paciente.NroHistoria
  INNER JOIN dir_comunica ON salud_paciente.k_id = dir_comunica.IdRegistro
  INNER JOIN dir_comunicadir ON dir_comunicadir.IdComunica = dir_comunica.k_id

SELECT 
	 mapeosector.Tipo AS TipoSector, 
     SUM(flow_coordinamapeo.Estadia) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.Cod) AS Promedio
FROM
  flow_coordina f
  INNER JOIN flow_coordinamapeo ON (f.Cod = flow_coordinamapeo.CodCoordina AND flow_coordinamapeo.Estadia > 0)
  INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc ON (flow_coordinamapeo.IdPlantaContenido = pc.k_id)
  INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc2 ON (pc2.k_id = pc.IdContenido)
  INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc3 ON (pc3.k_id = pc2.IdContenido)
  INNER JOIN mapeosector ON (pc2.k_id = mapeosector.IdPlantaContenido)
  WHERE f.Realizado = 255
  AND f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
    AND YEAR(f.FechaRealizado) = {{Anio}}

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]
GROUP BY mapeosector.Tipo
ORDER BY mapeosector.Tipo;

SELECT 
    ms.Tipo AS Sector,
	SUM(m.Estadia) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.Cod) AS Promedio
FROM (
    SELECT Cod, FechaRealizado, Realizado, CodCoordinaReglaMotivo, Hbritanico, CodDestinoFact
    FROM flow_coordina
    WHERE Realizado = 255
      AND CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
    ORDER BY FechaRealizado DESC
    LIMIT 35
) f
INNER JOIN flow_coordinamapeo m 
    ON f.Cod = m.CodCoordina
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc 
    ON m.IdPlantaContenido = pc.k_id
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc2 
    ON pc2.k_id = pc.IdContenido
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc3 
    ON pc3.k_id = pc2.IdContenido
INNER JOIN mapeosector ms 
    ON pc2.k_id = ms.IdPlantaContenido
WHERE 1=1

      [[AND (({{sede}} = 'SMI' AND COALESCE(f.Hbritanico, 0) = 0) OR ({{sede}} = 'Britanico' AND f.Hbritanico = 1))]]
      [[AND (({{facturacion}} = 'FNR' AND f.CodDestinoFact = 3) OR ({{facturacion}} = 'Otro' AND COALESCE(f.CodDestinoFact, 0) <> 3))]]

GROUP BY ms.Tipo
ORDER BY ms.Tipo;
